import { assign, setup } from "../../../src/index.js"
import { markAgentLogic } from "../../../src/internal/agentBrand.js"
import { fromEffect } from "../../../src/actors/index.js"
import { child } from "./support.js"
import { Effect, Option } from "effect"

/** Detect contextual types erased to any. */
type IsAny<T> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? true : false
/** Require the complete completion output type. */
type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false
/** Turn each expected type into a compiler obligation. */
const exact = <T extends true>(): void => undefined
/** The first agent completes with a numeric output. */
const agent = markAgentLogic(fromEffect(() => Effect.succeed(1)))
/** The second agent exercises an onDone transition array. */
const slow = markAgentLogic(fromEffect(() => Effect.succeed(1)))
/** Ordinary actors can share an invocation array with agents. */
const worker = fromEffect(() => Effect.succeed(1))
/** The declared context supplies nested completion callbacks. */
const s = setup({ types: {} as { context: { count: number }; events: { type: "GO" } }, actors: { agent, slow, worker, child } })

/** Nested invocation arrays retain callback types and settlement structure. */
export const array = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 }, initial: "work",
  states: {
    work: {
      on: { GO: {} },
      invoke: [
        {
          src: "agent",
          onDone: { target: "done", actions: ({ event }) => {
            exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof event.output, Option.Option<number>>>()
          } },
          onSnapshot: { actions: () => undefined }
        },
        {
          src: "slow",
          onDone: [{ guard: ({ event }) => {
            exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof event.output, Option.Option<number>>>()
            return true
          }, target: "done" }, "done"]
        },
        { src: "worker" }
      ]
    },
    done: { type: "final" }
  }
})

/** The function form of assign keeps the output type inside nested onDone actions. */
export const doneAssigned = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 }, initial: "work",
  states: {
    work: {
      on: { GO: {} },
      invoke: { src: "agent", onDone: { target: "done", actions: assign(({ context, event }) => {
        exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event.output>, false>>()
        exact<Equal<typeof event.output, Option.Option<number>>>()
        return { count: Option.getOrElse(event.output, () => context.count) }
      }) } }
    },
    done: { type: "final" }
  }
})
